_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Every server here is also gated by mcp.allowedServers in config/acp-permissions.json, which the ACP shim enforces on each tool call - being listed here only makes a server reachable, never permitted. The server key is what appears in the permission title, so it must match the allowlist key exactly. This file must stay portable and secret-free, so it carries no absolute paths and no credentials: ${poc:<relpath>} expands to an absolute path under the POC root and ${file:<relpath>} to the contents of a gitignored file, both resolved by the shim when it materialises runtime/cursor-home/.cursor/mcp.json. AWS servers need neither - their credentials come from runtime/aws/credentials via the isolated HOME, and on ECS from the task role.
